title: Letter 44 — Seek Souls, Not the Things of Men
attribution_note: Letter 44 of 46 in the collection Letters Sent — see Letter 1 for provenance.

sections.heading: Counsel for a shepherd of Christ's flock

pairs.en: Father John, beloved brother in Christ!

I have received two letters from you; for both I give thanks. I send you, according to your desire, my counsel. Read it and consider, and act thus; but more still, read books yourself, and from them learn both to shepherd yourself and the people entrusted to you by God; and pray to God diligently, that God Himself may instruct you to shepherd Christ's flock. Moreover remember this: seek men, and not the things of men — that is, seek the salvation of souls, and not money, and riches, and honour.
Be saved in Christ, and pray to God for me, a sinner.
